nodes.label: postgres compose service
nodes.rationale: postgres:16-alpine with a pg_isready healthcheck and a named volume; the healthcheck exists so the api service can gate on service_healthy rather than racing the database.

nodes.label: api compose service
nodes.rationale: Built from the repo root context with apps/Dockerfile (same as Railway/CI), all third-party keys default to empty so the API boots in stub mode, and the DB host defaults to the compose service name `postgres`, not localhost.

nodes.label: Redis service commented out
nodes.rationale: Redis is scaffolded but not wired into AppModule, so its compose service, volume and depends_on entry are kept commented rather than deleted — ready to uncomment when cache/queues land.

hyperedges.label: Containerised API boot contract (compose, CI, local stack)
